text: This week's mistake: starting work with no written quote.
It feels quicker. A handshake, a number on the phone, and work begins.
Then the bill arrives, and the number has changed, or the material isn't what you thought.
Without paper, it's your memory against theirs.
So before work starts, ask for a written quote.
What work is included. Which materials, and which grade or type. And how payments are tied to stages.
Read it, ask about anything missing, and keep a signed copy.
Send this to someone about to start building.
